help.slack.step1: Create a Slack app for your workspace at api.slack.com/apps (from scratch).
help.slack.step2: In the app’s settings, turn on Incoming Webhooks.
help.slack.step3: Choose Add New Webhook to Workspace and pick the channel.
help.slack.step4: Copy the webhook URL, which starts with https://hooks.slack.com/services/, and paste it here.
help.teams.note: Microsoft retired the old Office 365 connector webhooks, so a Teams destination needs a workflow.
help.teams.step1: In Teams, open the Workflows app and create a workflow from the template that posts to a channel when a webhook request is received (it may be named “Send webhook alerts to a channel”).
help.teams.step2: Pick the team and channel where the messages should appear, and finish the setup.
help.teams.step3: Copy the HTTP URL that the workflow shows for its webhook trigger.
help.teams.step4: Paste it here. It comes from powerplatform.com or logic.azure.com.

outcome.blockedAddress: The address points inside a network or to an address that is never allowed, so nothing was sent.
outcome.disabled: The destination is switched off, so nothing was sent.
outcome.dnsFailed: The address could not be looked up. It will be tried again.
outcome.hostNotAllowed: The address is not from Slack or Microsoft and the destination does not allow other hosts, so nothing was sent.
outcome.networkError: The connection failed. It will be tried again.
outcome.payloadRejected: The service did not accept the message. Please report this.
outcome.rateLimited: The service asked Kiln to slow down. It will be tried again after the wait it named.
outcome.redirected: The address redirects elsewhere, which Kiln does not follow. Paste the final address.
outcome.secretUnreadable: The saved address could not be read. Paste it again.
outcome.serverError: The service had a problem. It will be tried again.
outcome.timeout: The service did not answer in time. It will be tried again.
outcome.webhookGone: The webhook no longer exists. Create a new one and paste its address here.
outcome.webhookRejected: The service refused the webhook. It may have been disabled or restricted; check it in Slack or Teams.
